name: dg-app-full
description: Dhamma.gift offline Android/iOS app. The UI is not maintained here — it is generated from a dg-node checkout at build time (see paths.js / DG_NODE_PATH); this repo holds only the app's own files: the fetch shim, the native bridge, the build scripts and the native platform projects.

scripts.build: node build-page.js && node build-core-bundle.js && node build-assets.js
